title: 大鹅
setting: A village lane in the northeast, early morning, breakfast in hand.

wang.name: 王大爷
wang.en: Grandpa Wang, who owns the goose

caught.narr: The goose knocks you flat, snatches the bun out of your hand and strolls off.
caught.zh: 大鹅把你撞倒，叼走了你的馒头。

caught.en: Oh dear. It only wanted the bun.
Caught. Mugged by a goose, for a steamed bun.

steps.narr: Your friend's granny pressed a steamed bun on you for the road. Off you go down the lane.
steps.zh: 朋友的奶奶塞给你一个馒头。

steps.narr: A goose stands in the lane, a snapped rope dangling from one leg. It has seen you.
steps.zh: 一只大鹅，腿上拴着半截绳子。

say.tip: 走开 zǒukāi = go away. 开 after a verb means 'off, away': 走开, 让开, 拿开.

steps.narr: Wings out, neck low. It's charging.

say.tip: 别 bié = don't. 过来 = come over here. 别 + any verb = don't: 别动, 别跑, 别过来.

ok.narr: It hesitates. You sprint for the village.

say.tip: 有人吗? yǒu rén ma = anyone there? The first thing to shout at any door, shop counter or phone.

say.en: Get him to take it away!
say.tip: 把 puts 'it' first: 快把它牵走 = quick, lead it away. 牵 qiān = lead on a rope, like a dog on a lead.

mistakes.note: 拿走 is for things you pick up and carry off. A goose on a rope is 牵走.

ok.en: All right, all right, don't be scared!

ok.narr: He grabs for the rope, and misses.
ok.zh: 大爷一把抓过去，没抓着。

say.tip: 我警告你 wǒ jǐnggào nǐ = I'm warning you. Said to geese, little brothers and TV villains.

ok.narr: Nobody has ever warned this goose before. It tilts its head. You slip past.
ok.zh: 大鹅歪着头看你。你趁机溜了。

fail.narr: It isn't scared in the least.

say.en: Shoo! Tell it you've got nothing!
answers: 走开走开！我什么也没有！
快走开！我身上什么都没有！
say.gloss: Go away! I haven't got anything!
say.tip: 什么都没有 = nothing at all. 什么都 + a negative = not anything: 什么都不知道, 什么都没吃.

ok.narr: The goose stares at your hand. Only at your hand.

steps.zh: 它不是要咬你，它是要你的馒头！
steps.en: It's not after you. It's after your bun!

steps.narr: You look down. The steamed bun. You've been holding it the whole time.
steps.zh: 你低头一看：馒头还在手里。

say.tip: 给你 gěi nǐ = here you go. Doubled, 给你给你 is 'here, here, take it!'

ok.narr: The goose takes the bun and waddles off, very pleased with itself.
ok.zh: 大鹅叼着馒头，大摇大摆地走了。

steps.en: That goose. Buns are all it cares about.

steps.zh: 你保住了裤子，丢了早饭。
